metadata.title: SGA 1, SGA 2, SGA 5, and SGA 6: Modern LaTeX Working Editions, Bounded Translations, and Audit Materials
metadata.version: 2026-07-19 SGA1 through I.6; SGA2 Exposes V-VI; direct cumulative TeX
metadata.description:
This record contains machine-assisted modern-LaTeX working editions, bounded translations, source workpasses, and audit materials for SGA 1, SGA 2, SGA 5, and SGA 6.

Direct downloads: the current bounded SGA 1 and SGA 2 English readers are supplied as direct, single-file PDF and cumulative TeX downloads. Evidence archives remain separate supplements rather than hiding editable readers inside ZIP files.

SGA 1: the current bounded English checkpoint covers Expose I opening through section I.6, French authority lines 556-1216, and continues at excluded line 1217, section I.7. The direct cumulative TeX inlines the I.5 and I.6 fragments and was independently rebuilt to the same ten rendered pages as the modular evidence source.

SGA 2: the current bounded English checkpoints contain complete Exposes V and VI. Expose V covers corrected French lines 1770-2136. Expose VI covers lines 2139-2272 and continues at line 2274, Expose VII. SGA 1 and SGA 2 are both active translation lanes; neither volume is complete.

SGA 5 and SGA 6: the clean existing objects are retained byte-for-byte. SGA 5 is a selected ten-expose source-synchronized working edition, not complete SGA 5. SGA 6 retains explicit mixed authority layers and is not a uniform whole-volume source-faithful certification.

Evidence: the support archives retain editable TeX, source/formula/terminology/adverse ledgers, structural indices, append-only difficulty and revision records, path-safe build receipts, checksums, validation, and public-projection receipts. The current I.6 / Expose V visual archive indexes twenty-six project-generated images; the Expose VI visual archive indexes eleven. Neither contains French source pixels.

Status and rights: these are bounded working translations and source workpasses, not critical editions, peer review, proof certification, independent human review, accessibility certification, native/community certification, complete SGA volumes, or rights-clearance determinations. No blanket license over the French sources or new English translations is asserted. The record rights field is therefore License Not Specified.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

additional_descriptions.description: SGA 1 Expose I is source-audited through section I.6 and continues at I.7. SGA 2 Exposes V and VI are complete as separate bounded checkpoints; production continues at Expose VII. Direct cumulative TeX accompanies each current bounded SGA 1/2 PDF. SGA 5 remains a selected ten-expose working edition, not a complete volume. SGA 6 remains a mixed-layer working reader rather than a uniform source-faithful edition. The current visual packages contain 37 project-generated renders and no French-source pixels. No critical-edition, independent-human-review, completion, certification, accessibility, or rights-clearance claim is made.

access_status.description_l10n: The record and files are publicly accessible.
